channel.title: AI Builder's Field Guide — Recently Added
channel.description: A daily-curated wiki of the tools, models, and patterns that AI power-users and builders actually reach for.

item.title: Tencent Hy-SimulMT
item.description: Tencent open-sourced Hy-SimulMT, a model for real-time Chinese-English simultaneous interpretation with translated text and speech output, including real-time voice cloning. — This open-source model offers low-latency, high-quality simultaneous translation with voice cloning, making it valuable for applications requiring real-time, natural-sounding multilingual communication.

item.title: Hi3D V1.0
item.description: Hi3D is an open-source model for generating high-resolution 3D geometry from images or text. — Hi3D focuses on high-resolution 3D geometry generation. Its production validation makes it a reliable choice for workflows that require only geometry, unlike Tripo3D which provides a full asset pipeline including texturing and rigging.

item.title: PixVerse
item.description: PixVerse generates video from text or images, offering camera control and character consistency. — PixVerse provides more granular control over camera movements and character consistency than general text-to-video models like Luma Dream Machine. Use it when precise scene composition and consistent character appearance are critical for short-form narrative video.

item.title: Spira Maxima
item.description: Spira Maxima is an AI social media agent that generates, schedules, and publishes short-form videos and images from scripts using viral templates. — It automates the entire social media content pipeline, from creation to scheduling, posting, and performance analysis, offering a comprehensive solution beyond single-task video generators.

item.title: Meta Muse Spark 1.3
item.description: Meta Muse Spark 1.3 is a multimodal reasoning model from Meta, tuned for agentic workflows and coding, available through Meta Model API. — It offers advanced capabilities for multi-step tasks and tool use, establishing Meta as a new major provider in the hosted frontier model space.

item.title: AnySearch AI
item.description: AnySearch AI provides privacy-first search infrastructure for AI agents, offering structured access to high-quality information from diverse vertical domains beyond the public web. — It enables AI agents to access secure, reliable, and structured data from authenticated professional systems, which traditional search engines cannot reach, crucial for sophisticated agent tasks.

item.title: Google Gemini Agent
item.description: A unified AI agent from Google designed for workplace tasks, capable of operating across various Google and third-party applications. — It functions as a proactive digital colleague, distinguishing itself from earlier AI assistants by autonomously completing multi-step assignments within enterprise workflows.

item.title: Agent-Reach
item.description: A CLI tool that grants AI agents access to search and read content from various internet platforms like Twitter, Reddit, and YouTube without API fees. — This provides a broad, free web-browsing capability for agents, expanding their information retrieval beyond traditional search APIs and specific vector stores.
